description: (kinker-1-29 pands 6-8, Kinkerstraat 19-23, 1885): plain red-brown brick, 3 axes, segmental heads without dressing, iron anchors, bracketed cornice with carved end consoles, broken in the middle by a brick wall dormer (one light, flat cap with an iron finial) over the centre axis. A library type of its own because no other type has a centre-axis wall dormer: plain-brick has only pediment dormers, brick-arched's tower crown spans axes 0-1 of a 2-axis module.

wall-dormer.note: a brick wall dormer over the centre axis rising one storey through the cornice, one light, flat cap (19, 21, 23)

rhythm.roofline: bracketed cornice broken by a centre brick wall dormer
schemaLimits: carved end consoles of the cornice
iron finial on the dormer cap

strip.jpg 2024-12-11 pands 7-8 (Kinkerstraat 21, 23): the same body and wall dormer over a later shop insert: the first storey white-painted over the whole width with four lights (placement overrides bays [1,4,3,3,3] and paintedStoreys); palette-from-strip walls #69533f, #6f5d49

notes: Palette: median of the three pands on palette-from-strip (#67523f, #69533f, #6f5d49).

Promoted to the Oud-West library 2026-10-14 (lane kinker-colour-fidelity) from kinker-1-29 inline; the first palette is the inline one, so placements resolve unchanged. Per-pand palettes are palette-from-strip medians (wall, frame, band as stone).
